learn_no_model: No model yet. It is created automatically as soon as master comparisons or verdicts exist.
learn_summary: Learned from {events} detections classified by a master ({recs} recordings) and {manual} manual verdicts · as of {date}{applied}
learn_one_record: So far everything comes from a single record with a master. Whether the estimate fits other music and pressings only shows with a second record with a master; until then, better not compute the grade from the estimate.
title: Settings
docs_title: What grades, smileys, metrics and buttons mean
clipping_hint: Defaults 5 s, 200 and 500 samples. Applies to new analyses; re-analyze existing recordings if needed.
language_help: For the interface and the PDF reports. Applies in this browser; the page reloads.
targets: Targets (target values for the turntable check)
device_service_hint: These values are in {file} and cannot be changed here because the service may not write there. Restart the service after changing the file.
discogs_hint: Discogs is the primary database: search and record condition come from the collection (cached, refreshed daily); saving to the collection writes the measured record condition back there. Sleeve and notes stay untouched.
discogs_app_ready: The Discogs app is set up, but the account has not been authorized yet.
discogs_connect_hint: The Discogs authorization page opens. After “Authorize” the browser returns here and the collection is synced. The station never sees your password.
discogs_not_set_up: Not set up. In {file}, enter either discogs_token = "…" + discogs_username = "…" (personal access token) or discogs_consumer_key/secret (Discogs app, then authorized here with a button), then restart the service. The app keeps working without Discogs; records are then added by hand.
discogs_confirm_disconnect: Remove the Discogs authorization from this station? Your collection on Discogs stays unchanged.
retention_off: Retention is off (0 days): nothing to delete.

retention_confirm.one: Delete original audio older than {n} day now? Measurements, spectrograms and grades remain. This cannot be undone.
